meta.description: Canonical interview-guide questions for the WCT GLP-1 weight-maintenance trial study. Interviewer turns in question_map.json are normalized to these question_ids so participant responses can be compared across interviews.

turn_roles.question: Interviewer turn that poses a canonical question for the first time in the interview.
turn_roles.probe: Follow-up, clarification, or sub-item within an already-open question topic.
turn_roles.acknowledgment: Interviewer turn with no question (e.g. 'Oh, okay'); inherits the surrounding topic for response continuity.
turn_roles.admin: Logistics, introduction, or closing; not analytical content.

notes: The actual interviewer wording of every mapped turn lives in interviews_structured.json (with char offsets); this codebook holds only the canonical form, so question variants are not duplicated here.
This codebook is editable and versioned; bump schema_version when questions are added or revised.

questions.canonical_question: Why would you consider stopping a GLP-1 medication, and what factors would influence that decision?
Would you consider trying a different medication from the one you currently take?
Would you consider participating in a clinical trial with a new medication that is not yet approved?
What factors, reasons, or incentives would attract you to taking part in a clinical trial?
How do you feel about a placebo-controlled study, including one offering commercial medication after the initial period?
Would taking monthly injections over a 36-week period be a barrier to participating?
How likely are you to purchase compounded semaglutide versus an approved product?
What barriers (e.g. fasting blood, glucose monitoring, visit frequency, travel) would affect your participation in a trial?
Are there any other concerns you would want to discuss with the study doctors before signing up?
What educational, diet, exercise, or lifestyle support would be most valuable to you?
How have you tried to lose weight in the past, before starting a GLP-1?
Have you considered or looked into taking part in a clinical trial before now?
How aware are you of other weight-loss drugs in development, such as oral GLP-1s, and what is your perception of them?
What are your thoughts on oral GLP-1s versus injectable medications?
Closing: anything else to add, and wrap-up.
